text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet meeting approves law shaping constitutional reform. Referendum to decide whether parliament should split into two chambers is due on September 13.
- Morocco's Salah Issou breaks the men's 10,000 world record in Brussels.
- Euro-Maghreb gas pipeline to start operating in October.
- World Bank says Morocco should reform insurance and banking sector to reduce unemployment.
- Huge fire destroys shantytown in Casablanca.
- Tangier main transiting route for Moroccan expatriates returning home for summer.
